question: Hello, I'm Tibi. I'd like to understand how things work at BeePee, in your own words. There are no wrong answers, and you can pause or stop whenever you like. Could we start with your name, and what you do?
answer: Carrying out cashiering is basically the ability to serve customers when they request a product that sits behind a tail or counter So, how this works? First of all, customer comes to the cashier, comes to the counter and they request a product that sits behind the TIL, T-I-L-L. And then what happens is the cashier has three choices, so there are three different branches of the process that follows from then on. First option is if the customer requests e-cigarette or Tabaco product. This is when the cashier will carry out an age verification check, so it will request an ID from a customer. Once the verification is completed, cashier will ask customer what type of Tabaco product they want. Once that's done, they will locate that product in dedicated drawer, which is in alphabetical order. Once that product is retrieved by cashier, then cashier will scan it on point of sale. Point of sale will then prompt the cashier to confirm if they've done the age verification and once that's confirmed by cashier, the product will be added to the basket. The second option or second branch of that process is focused on age restricted product, but it's non-Tabaco. So, for example, energy drink. If the customer requests that, then cashier will locate that product that they requested. They will scan it on point of sale. And then because it's an age restricted product, the point of sale will again prompt the cashier to carry out age verification check. Once the customer produces valid ID confirming the age that is required for that product, cashier can close this verification prompt on point of sale and product will be added to the basket. The final option in that process is when customer asks for a product that doesn't require age verification, so this is a simply cashier will locate the product, will scan it on point of sale, will review obviously what has been produced in terms of the ticket on the point of sale and product will be added to the basket. That's the process so far.
